name: Quiet Mind
description: Meditative study music for headphones: slow, soft pieces for long sessions of reading, writing and thinking, each using the space between your ears to settle the mind. An alpha beat under a singing bowl, sparse theta piano with rain beyond the glass, a pad that breathes from the centre of your head to all around it, brightness drifting between the ears, a drone rolling slowly inside your head, two hands that trade ears, strings that drift apart in cents, a harp that widens bar by bar, a phrase hidden in soft noise, a quiet beta lantern for alert focus and a delta music box to put the pens down. Slow tempos, low levels and nothing sudden; each sketch explains its trick in the comments. Headphones on, volume low.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Settling In
sketches.description: The start of a session: a soft D major pad that breathes over eight bars, a singing bowl every four bars and wide, quiet air, over a 10 Hz binaural drone in the alpha range. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.

sketches.name: Theta Notes
sketches.description: Deep reading: a sparse, seeded piano that never plays the same phrase twice, soft chords in D minor and rain beyond the window, over a quiet 6 Hz binaural beat in the theta range. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.
sketches.source:
setcpm(56/4)

// A 6 Hz binaural beat in the theta range, following the roots: keep the volume low
drone: note("<d2 bb1 g1 a1>").slow(2).s("sine").binaural(6)
  .attack(3).sustain(1).release(4).gain(.14)

// Sparse piano from the minor pentatonic, never quite the same twice
piano: n(irand(8).segment(4)).scale("D:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.55).seed("theta")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(.005).decay(1.4).sustain(.08).release(1.6)
  .room(.6).size(.85).gain(.24)

// Soft chords, two bars each: Dm, Bb, Gm, A
chords: note("<[d3,f3,a3] [bb2,d3,f3] [g2,bb2,d3] [a2,c#3,e3]>").slow(2)
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(2).sustain(.6).release(3)
  .lpf(900).room(.6).gain(.14)

// Rain beyond the window, heard through the glass
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.35).occlude(.6).gain(.16)

sketches.name: Breathing Room
sketches.description: A pad in C steps through the interaural phase: in phase it sits in the centre of your head, at 90 degrees it loosens and at 180 it spreads into a haze around you. A soft rush of air guides one slow breath every ten seconds. On speakers the 180-degree chords nearly vanish.

sketches.name: Paper and Ink
sketches.description: Writing at a desk: nothing is panned, yet the brightness of a soft broken-chord figure drifts slowly from ear to ear, as each ear has its own low-pass sweeping the other way every eight bars. A fire crackles on your left and a clock ticks on your right.

sketches.name: Slow Orbit
sketches.description: A drone whose phase turns slowly between the ears, from once every five seconds to just under once a second, so it rolls gently inside your head, under a hushed choir. Glass notes circle you once every sixteen bars. All rates stay well below 3 Hz.
sketches.source:
setcpm(44/4)

// irate turns the drone's phase between the ears, in turns per second
// All rates stay below 3 Hz, so no pulse warning is needed
drone: note("[e2,b2]").s("sine").irate("<.2 .4 .8 .4>")
  .attack(2).sustain(1).release(2).gain(.2)

// A hushed choir on slow chords: Em, C, Am, B
choir: note("<[e3,g3,b3] [c3,e3,g3] [a2,c3,e3] [b2,d#3,f#3]>").slow(2)
  .s("choir").syl("<oo ah oo oh>").attack(3).release(4).space("hall").gain(.18)

// Glass notes circling your head once every sixteen bars, a little above
glass: n(irand(6).segment(4)).scale("E:minor pentatonic").transpose(24)
  .degradeBy(.6).seed("orbit")
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(1).sustain(0).release(2)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(16)).elevation(20).distance(3).posglide(.5)
  .room(.6).gain(.08)

sketches.name: Two Hands, Two Ears
sketches.description: Generative piano in A minor pentatonic: two hands share one seeded melody, one leaning into each ear through a level difference, and every four bars they trade places. A held fifth and a distant stream keep the room still. Change the seed for a new take.

sketches.name: Cents of Calm
sketches.description: A kalimba plays a slow figure in G, the same in both ears, over strings whose ears drift a few cents apart and back again: 2 cents beats slowly, 4 shimmers and 8 widens softly around you.

sketches.name: Widening Harp
sketches.description: A harp rolls slow broken chords in C while a delay between the ears, rising from 1 to 20 milliseconds, keeps it on one side but widens it bar by bar. A flute sings in the centre with no delay at all, and rain falls outside.

sketches.name: Quiet Signal
sketches.description: Soft breaths of white noise that, between the ears, carry a slow phrase (Huggins pitch); each ear alone hears only hiss. A quiet sine plays the first phrase every four bars so you know what to listen for, over a soft pad and a singing bowl. The effect is faint and differs between listeners.

sketches.name: Beta Lantern
sketches.description: For alert, steady focus: a gentle marimba figure in A minor and a soft kick over a pad that sends alternate partials to each ear, complete only when both ears hear it, with a very quiet 14 Hz binaural drone in the beta range. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.
sketches.source:
setcpm(72/4)

// A 14 Hz binaural beat in the beta range: each ear is detuned by 7 Hz. Keep it very quiet
drone: note("[a2,e3]").slow(4).s("sine").binaural(14)
  .attack(3).sustain(1).release(4).gain(.07)

// earsplit("harmonics") alternates the pad's partials between the ears: Am, F, C, G
pad: note("<[a2,e3,c4] [f2,c3,a3] [c3,g3,e4] [g2,d3,b3]>")
  .s("sawtooth").earsplit("harmonics").lpf(1400)
  .attack(1).sustain(.8).release(2).room(.5).gain(.1)

// A gentle marimba figure, the same in both ears
marimba: n("0 2 4 2 5 4 2 4").add("<0 -2 2 -1>").scale("A:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").fm(.6).fmh(4).decay(.35).sustain(0).room(.3).gain(.18)

// A soft kick on the downbeat and a centred root
kick: s("bd ~ ~ ~").lpf(200).gain(.3)
bass: note("<a1 f1 c2 g1>").s("sine").attack(.1).sustain(.6).release(.8).gain(.26)

sketches.name: Pens Down
sketches.description: The end of the session: a music box in 3/4 floating a little above your head, over a 2 Hz binaural drone in the delta range, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning, with warm brown noise and crickets far away.
